Class CliodynamicMetricsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.metrics.CliodynamicMetricsHelper
public final class CliodynamicMetricsHelper extends Object

CliodynamicMetricsHelper

Calculates Structural-Demographic Theory (SDT) vulnerability indicators, elite overproduction, fiscal distress, collective solidarity (Ibn Khaldun's Asabiyyah), institutional maturity, and societal collapse risk (Peter Turchin, Jack Goldstone, Joseph Tainter).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    Evaluates Durkheimian division of labor and occupational specialization index ($0$ to $100$) from metabolic energy surplus $\Phi$, physical tool density $k_{\text{pc}}$, and demographic scale $\log_{10}(N)$ (Durkheim 1893; Carneiro 1967).

    Evaluates Turchin elite overproduction index ($0.0$ to $4.5$) directly from physical capital surplus $k_{\text{pc}} = K/N$ and Lorenz Gini stratification.
    double

    Evaluates Goldstone/Turchin state fiscal stress index ($0.0$ to $100.0$).
